scripts.bundle: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --outfile=dist/index.js --external:firebase-admin --external:firebase-admin/* --external:firebase-functions --external:firebase-functions/* --external:@google-cloud/tasks --external:@google-cloud/tasks/* --banner:js="import { createRequire as __cr } from 'module'; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);"
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run bundle
